items.headline: Peru keeps 3.4 percent growth forecast for 2026 despite El Niño and seeks supplementary credit
items.summary: Economy and Finance Minister Elmer Cuba said on 7 October that the ministry maintains its forecast of 3.4 percent growth for 2026 despite the expected effects of El Niño, and about 4 percent once it passes. He presented a supplementary credit request of S/ 8,228 million to Congress, including S/ 581 million for El Niño response. The central bank is more cautious at 3.2 percent.
items.note: The 3.2 percent central bank forecast is from La República's report of the September revision. The supplementary credit details come from Infobae, dated 6 October.
